encoding.nextViewName: nextViewName(base, existing): the trimmed base when no existing name equals it, else the first free "<base> (n)" for n = 1, 2, ... Existing names are trimmed and compared case-sensitively. existing is every view name of the target database as the folder names them.
encoding.duplicateBaseName: duplicateBaseName(name): the trimmed name with one trailing " (n)" removed (n is digits only). A duplicate is named nextViewName(duplicateBaseName(source), existing).

nextViewName.name: a free base is used as is
the first free number fills a gap
a numbered base gets its own number

duplicateBaseName.name: only the last number is removed
parentheses that are not a number stay
a number without the space stays
